shots.action: fight across the dunes with staffs and ropes
shots.lockedLookBlock: Wuxia desert epic in painterly live-action style, ochre sand and blood-red dusk against cold moonlit blue night, tattered grey-brown beggar robes against ornate dark Qing robes, dust and sand in the air, dynamic wuxia wire-fu camera with sweeping crane and tracking moves, high contrast, no modern objects, no saturated neon.

lockedCharacterBlocks.Chief Hong: a weathered one-eyed beggar chief in his 60s with a grey beard, patched grey-brown robes, a rope belt, and a knotted wooden staff, moving with slow, deliberate authority
lockedCharacterBlocks.Little Sparrow: a lean young beggar woman in her 20s with short black hair tied back, patched grey-brown robes, straw sandals, and a rope whip at her belt, moving fast and light across the sand
lockedCharacterBlocks.Jiangshi: hopping vampires in rotting dark Qing robes with faded gold trim, paper talismans on their foreheads, arms held stiffly forward, green-grey skin, moving in stiff, hopping formation

shots.background: Foreground: sand spray from footwork. Midground: band and vampires meeting in the dunes. Deep background: dunes at night, moon behind the vampires so they read as silhouettes.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): Band and vampires meet. Spatial layout: beggars left and centre, vampires right, moon behind vampires. Beat 2 (3-7s): Three simultaneous exchanges, each readable and not crossing another's space: Hong staff centre, Sparrow rope left, two extras with bowls and short staffs right. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): A vampire is knocked back into the sand, dust bursting, band holds formation, cut on the dust burst.
shots.cameraChoreography: Crane: starts at 2 metres, rises to 5 metres during beat 2 to show all three exchanges, then holds on the dust burst.
shots.lighting: Cold moonlight with warm lantern glow from the caravanserai behind the camera, vampires backlit as silhouettes, beggars front-lit.
shots.focus: Deep focus: all three exchanges readable, no exchange blurred out.
shots.motion: Subject motion: three exchanges at once, each with its own rhythm. Background motion: dust and sand spray. Camera rises, then holds — it does not chase individual fighters.
shots.extras: Five to seven beggar extras and five vampires, all in the layout above, no one crossing another's space.
shots.loreNotes: Jiangshi rules 1, 5, 7: hop only, arms stiff, knocked back not destroyed. Beggar rule: no swords, only staffs, bowls, ropes, anything to hand.

departments.choreography: Spatial layout is the deliverable: beggars left/centre, vampires right, moon behind vampires
departments.costume: Hong left shoulder tear opens in this shot and must persist in s09
departments.sound: Music enters here for the first time: driving percussion, no melody yet

shots.action: leaps over three vampires at once
shots.lockedLookBlock: Wuxia desert epic in painterly live-action style, ochre sand and blood-red dusk against cold moonlit blue night, tattered grey-brown beggar robes against ornate dark Qing robes, dust and sand in the air, dynamic wuxia wire-fu camera with sweeping crane and tracking moves, high contrast, no modern objects, no saturated neon.

shots.background: Foreground: three vampires in a line, arms up, hopping in place. Midground: Sparrow in mid-leap above them. Deep background: moon, large and low, with dune silhouettes.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): Sparrow runs toward the three vampires, gathering speed, rope whip trailing. Beat 2 (3-7s): She leaps, wire-assisted, in a high arc over all three vampires; the vampires hop in place beneath her, arms up, missing. Beat 3, payoff, landing (7-10s): Landing in a crouch in the sand, sand spraying forward, Sparrow already turning to face them, hold on the landing crouch.
shots.cameraChoreography: Tracking: camera tracks at Sparrow's leap height, not below, following her arc from run to landing, ending on the crouch.
shots.lighting: Moonlight from behind the vampires, Sparrow lit from the front by moonlight reflected off sand, landing dust catching the light.
shots.focus: Focus follows Sparrow through the arc; vampires slightly soft beneath her, sharp again at landing.
shots.motion: Subject motion: run, leap arc, landing crouch. Background motion: vampires hopping in place, sand spray on landing. Camera tracks at height — a camera below the leap would lose the arc.
shots.extras: The three vampires are the only other figures; no beggar extras in this shot, so the leap reads cleanly.
shots.loreNotes: Jiangshi rules 1 and 5: hop in place, arms up, missing — they do not catch, grab, or run. Sparrow rule: fastest fighter, so she is the one who leaps.

departments.choreography: Wire-fu deliverable: arc, apex, and landing specified; a leap without a landing is not a move
departments.makeup-sfx: Sand spray on landing, dust catching moonlight
departments.sound: Whoosh on the leap, sand spray on landing, theme phrase on bowed string, heard once in full here

shots.background: Foreground: band silhouettes standing still. Midground: dunes at dawn, dust settling. Deep background: second tomb door, far away, closed at the start of the shot and grinding open by the end, with the same lintel motif as s04.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): Band stands still at dawn, no celebration, no walking. Beat 2 (3-7s): Dust settles around them, light rises. Beat 3, payoff, final hold (7-10s): The second tomb door grinds open by a few centimetres in the far distance, dust falling from its lintel, band still unaware, hold on the stillness with the door moving.
shots.cameraChoreography: Crane: slow rise from 2 metres to 4 metres, ending in an extreme wide shot with the band left, dunes centre, and the second tomb door right and small but visible.
shots.lighting: Dawn light, warm gold rising behind the band, silhouettes against the sun, second tomb door in cooler shadow so its movement reads by dust, not by light.
shots.focus: Deep focus: band, dunes, and second tomb door all sharp — the hook must be visible, not blurred out.
shots.motion: Subject motion: none for the band — stillness is the beat. Background motion: dust settling, and the second tomb door grinding open. Camera rises slowly, the only large movement.
shots.extras: The full band, five to seven beggars, standing still, torn robes, dust-caked, no one fresh at dawn.
shots.loreNotes: Geography rule: second tomb door is the same tomb-city as s04, connected by the lintel motif. Trailer rule: ends at tension 8 on a hook, not a resolution — the door beginning to open is the hook, not a door open.

departments.production-design: Second tomb door must be visible but unremarked; do not centre it, do not add a title over it
departments.costume: Hong left shoulder tear from s07 persists here
departments.sound: Dawn wind, distant stone grinding, theme phrase quieter, then cut to silence on the title
